description.p: A Winamp-inspired music player for Linux with a modern flat theme — LED clock, spectrum analyzer, and a 10-band equalizer, without the Windows-98 pixel art.

ul.li: Gapless playback and ReplayGain volume normalization
Direct Mode: bit-transparent output with the spectrum analyzer kept alive
ALSA direct output: exclusive DAC access, bypassing the desktop mixer
Internet radio (SHOUTcast/Icecast) with live now-playing titles
10-band equalizer with presets and LED-ladder spectrum meters
Playlists: durations, drag-reorder, type-to-search, Play Next queue, M3U import/export
Album art from embedded tags or folder art
MPRIS2 media keys, tray icon, desktop notifications, ListenBrainz scrobbling
Shuffle by tracks or albums, tri-state repeat, sleep timer

screenshot.caption: Main window: LCD panel, spectrum analyzer, equalizer, and playlist

description.p: Classic mode with real Winamp 2 skins, an oscilloscope, double size, crossfade, playlist sorting, a File Info window and Winamp's keyboard shortcuts, plus fixes for seeking near the end of a track.

Classic interface rework: a dedicated spectrum analyzer with peak caps, Llama Green, Classic Silver and Amber themes, collapsible and detachable equalizer and playlist panels, windowshade mode, playlist Undo, and improved queue and shuffle behavior.
Flatpak support: store-managed updates (the in-app update checker disables itself inside the sandbox) and Flathub packaging.
In-app update notifications and a GUI update flow.
Fixed song title and album art disagreeing during gapless playback.
